subject: Clarify bespoke retention & deletion timelines for FinServCo
messages:
From: Elena Moreno <compliance@finservco.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finservco.com
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bespoke retention windows + deletion timelines (order form language)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the product overview during last week's call. Our security and procurement teams reviewed Redwood's standard data lifecycle docs and we have a few follow-ups specifically about bespoke retention windows and guaranteed deletion timelines for regulated data. High level asks:

- We require EU data residency for all PII and inference inputs tied to EU customers; is that supported at the order form level?
- We need a contractual deletion guarantee for production data: deletion confirmation within 21 calendar days of contract termination (including customer-requested deletions). Your standard statement referencing “deleted within 45 days” won't pass our legal review.
- For backups and disaster recovery snapshots, we usually accept a longer window but would like explicit max windows (we're thinking 90 days).
- Certificate of deletion provided as a PDF and a reproducible audit trail (logs showing deletion actions, KMS key rotations, timestamps).

Can you share proposed order form wording and a sample deletion certificate? Also advise whether Dedicated/Private deployments change deletion commitments vs hosted. Procurement is looping in me + procurement@finservco.com for redlines.

Appreciate a short bulletized response we can share with legal.

Best,
Elena Moreno
Head of Compliance
FinServCo

--
Attachment: n/a

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <compliance@finservco.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bespoke retention windows + deletion timelines (order form language)

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. I've outlined answers below and attached a draft order form clause + a deletion-certificate template for your legal team to review (attached: bespoke-retention-order-draft.docx, deletion-certificate-template.pdf). Short summary first, then specifics.

Summary (quick bullets you can paste to legal):
- Residency: We can contractually require EU residency for processing and storage of PII and inference inputs by specifying the Region-of-Processing clause and pinning model serving to EU regions (AWS eu-west-1 / GCP europe-west1).
- Production deletion guarantee: For Hosted API, we can commit to deletion of live copies within 30 calendar days of termination by default; for a guaranteed 21-calendar-day SLA we require either (a) Dedicated capacity with EU-only tenancy or (b) Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment with customer-managed keys.
- Backups/snapshots: Configurable max retention windows; standard options we offer are 30 / 90 / 365 days. For your ask, we can contractually cap backups at 90 days for EU PII.
- Audit and certificate: We will provide a signed deletion certificate (PDF) plus a filtered audit log export showing deletion events, KMS key status, and object-level timestamps.

Detailed notes and proposed order form language (excerpt from attached DOCX):
- Region-of-Processing: "Supplier will ensure that all Customer Personal Data subject to EU residency requirements is stored and processed only in designated EU data centers (specifically: eu-west-1 and europe-west1) for the duration of the Order Form term."
- Production Data Deletion (hosted): "Supplier will delete or render unrecoverable all Customer Production Data within thirty (30) calendar days of the effective termination date, unless Customer selects Dedicated or Private deployment and contracts for accelerated deletion. Supplier will provide a Deletion Certificate within five (5) business days following deletion."
- Production Data Deletion (guaranteed 21d): "If Customer elects Dedicated Capacity or Redwood Private with EU-only tenancy and provides Customer KMS key control (if applicable), Supplier will delete or render unrecoverable all Customer Production Data within twenty-one (21) calendar days of the effective termination date and provide a signed Deletion Certificate within five (5) business days."
- Backups & Snapshots: "Backups, snapshots, and disaster recovery copies containing Customer Personal Data will be retained for no longer than the Backup Retention Period set forth in the Order Form (options: thirty (30), ninety (90), or three hundred sixty-five (365) days). After the Backup Retention Period expires, Supplier shall permanently delete such copies in accordance with its standard deletion process and document the deletion in audit logs."

Notes on technical controls:
- For Hosted customers wanting 21-day deletion we require either (1) Dedicated capacity with EU-only availability zones and customer pairing to a dedicated storage partition, or (2) Private deployment (VPC) with customer-managed KMS keys. The reason: hosted multi-tenant storage and cross-region replication make a 21d firm guarantee operationally risky without stricter isolation.
- Deletion process: object deletion -> KMS key rotation where applicable -> verification sweep -> issuance of Deletion Certificate (PDF) + audit export (CSV).

Next steps I propose:
1) If 21-day production deletion is a hard requirement, confirm whether you prefer Dedicated or Private. We can price both alternatives for the Order Form.
2) Legal can redline the attached DOCX; I'll coordinate with Rishi on acceptable legal language.
3) If helpful, we can run a 30-minute technical call with our infra team to validate the technical deletion path and logs.

I've looped in Lauren (legal ops) for contracting questions and Rishi (product security) for the technical acceptability of the 21-day SLA.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
viv@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112

Attachments: bespoke-retention-order-draft.docx, deletion-certificate-template.pdf

From: Elena Moreno <compliance@finservco.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finservco.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Bespoke retention windows + deletion timelines (order form language)

Vivek,

Thanks — that is helpful. A few clarifications from our side after an initial pass with legal:

- We can accept the Hosted 30‑day default for non-PII datasets, but EU customer PII must meet the 21-day deletion guarantee you outlined (production inputs and any derived embeddings that can be re-associated with identifiers).
- Backups: 90 days is acceptable.
- Deletion certificate + audit CSV: required, and procurement wants the certificate to include the S3/object paths or identifiers that were deleted (or clearly state if identifiers cannot be disclosed for security reasons).
- Private deployment: procurement is interested but wants ballpark OPEX delta vs Dedicated. Procurement will send a separate RFP question on cost.

Procurement has a legal contact who will do the redlines: Marta Ruiz (marta.ruiz@finservco.com). Please send the DOCX to procurement as well.

Can we also schedule a 30-minute call on Wednesday (Aug 5) 14:00 UTC to iron out the technical deletion process and confirm the audit fields?

Regards,
Elena
--
FinServCo Procurement (procurement@finservco.com)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <compliance@finservco.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marta.ruiz@finservco.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 14:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Bespoke retention windows + deletion timelines (order form language)

Elena —

Ack and thanks. I've sent the DOCX to procurement and added Marta to the thread. Confirming:
- We will draft order form language that offers the 21-day production deletion SLA conditioned on Dedicated (EU tenancy) or Private with customer KMS.
- Deletion certificate will enumerate deleted object IDs/paths and include a signed statement plus the audit export (CSV) showing timestamps and action IDs. If some identifiers are redacted for operational security we will clearly annotate why in the certificate.
- I'll have Rishi run through the audit fields with your team on the Wednesday call — 14:00 UTC on Aug 5 works for us. Calendar invite (DocuSign/redline link) will follow.

Lauren — thanks for picking up contracting questions; if you can prepare the alternate order form pricing bullets (Dedicated vs Private) for the call that would be great.

Regards,
Vivek
